# PaperTrade repository instructions

Read docs/SPEC.md before making changes. Work only on the selected phase and reuse existing phase outputs. Read only CSV headers and a few rows when inspecting data. Use the supplied CSVs unchanged, Python 3.12, FastAPI, SQLite and static HTML/CSS/JS. Keep the app offline at runtime. Follow the spec's money and time rules. Prefer small edits and concise handoffs. Report checks actually run.
